items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: 1989. Yeah, 1989, I got mine a long way, I even saw the names somewhere. Might have been Hank Jones, I don’t know, something like that. The studio was, I got mine in 1989 and it was a good time too because, oh yeah, check ’89 in there.
Yeah, ain’t that something? Look at that, me with Hank Jones. Look who got the next year.
